scientific_integrity: Proof from algebraic Fourier relations, normality, positivity and harmonic Poisson identities; supplementary finite numerical test does not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only normal multiplicative conditional expectations on the specified irrational-rotation lexicographic algebra; singular states and other semigroups not classified. Classical relative-entropy identity is prior mathematics. Bibliographic coverage of abstract ordered-crossed-product character theorems remains a residual risk.
title: Poisson-disk rigidity of normal multiplicative expectations on an irrational torus
